The series experienced a recovery from a mid-window dip (bottoming around 139.57) back to the 150-157 range, with some recent softening from the 157.79 peak to ~150.73. 

I attempted to incorporate three context events from the article (earnings approach, positive EPS revisions, Zacks Hold rating), but all were rejected because the article dates (March 2022) fall outside the price history window (early-to-mid 2020). With no events admitted, both the history-only and event-informed runs selected the same last_value model, producing a flat 33-step forecast at 153.7154. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but this is the best available forecast given the data constraints.
